checks.noAgent: No agent "{{id}}" in this project. Create it first.

check.title: Quick test run
check.hint: Runs the agent on one task with a practice model (no real model, free) and some injected faults. No API key is used. Any row marked FAIL means the agent will not run reliably in tests.
check.task: Task (optional, defaults to the benchmark's first)
check.needSuite: Name a benchmark to test against, for example {{suite}}.
check.tryRealHint: Runs one task on your worker with real model calls on your own key, exactly as an evaluation would. Use it for HTTP, OpenAI-compatible and A2A endpoints, which the practice model cannot test. It costs one task's model calls.

build.title: Prepare container
build.hintPerSuite: This agent needs one container per benchmark: name the benchmark.
build.hintPrebuilt: This agent uses a ready-made container image. Nothing to prepare.
build.nothing: Nothing to prepare. Add a build section in the Settings tab to prepare a container here.
build.runnerNote: Prepares the container on a worker (the shared worker or your own), never on the server. Runs also prepare it the first time they need it, so this step is optional; use it to see the build log before an evaluation.

diff.title: Compare versions
diff.hint: What changed between two versions of this agent and which tasks it now solves or fails. Each version needs saved runs on the same benchmark first.

tools.noAgent: Open an agent from the Agents page to edit its tools.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: A skill is a folder with a SKILL.md file that teaches the agent how to do something. Every upload is scanned for data theft, hidden instructions and risky install steps, and only a skill that passes is installed. Uploads are saved in {{dir}}/.
skills.confirmDelete: Delete skill {{name}}? Its files are removed from the project.
skills.empty: No skills yet. Upload a zipped skill folder below.
skills.notInstalled: The agent settings do not include {{dir}} yet, so runs do not install these skills. Upload again or add it in the Settings tab.
skills.name: Skill name
skills.admitted: Skill {{name}} passed the scan and is installed. Every run of this agent now installs it.
skills.blockedUpload: Skill {{name}} was not installed: the scan found {{count}} problems that block it.
skills.scanBlocked: Blocked by the scan: {{block}} problems that block, {{warn}} warnings.
skills.statusNotScanned: Not scanned: runs refuse it until it passes a scan.
skills.willSave: Will be saved as skill {{name}} in {{dir}}/{{name}}/.
skills.needZip: Choose a .zip of the skill folder (it must hold SKILL.md).
skills.tooLarge: The zip is larger than {{mb}} MiB.
skills.badName: Name the skill: letters, digits, '.', '-' or '_'.

mcp.title: MCP tools
mcp.hint: MCP servers give the agent extra tools. Choose how the agent is told about them and list the ones it should use, so you can scan them first. Tasks still decide which servers a run starts.
